action.objective: Convert the extra rook by forcing Kxh7, then win the g6 rook with Rg6.
action.rationale: Rxh7+ is the only commit-ready move: verified depth 4 exact 960, safety complete with no mate-in-one reply and tactical refutation not_found. Black must reply Kxh7, then Rg6 pins/wins the g6 rook, leaving White up material with a simple winning endgame.
